preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 2 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= n for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each element in the sequence a_i is between 1 and n.

postconditions.description: The minimum number of changes is non-negative.
The valid sequence has exactly n elements.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= v <= n for v in valid_sequence)
postconditions.description: Each element in the valid sequence is between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: sum(1 for i in range(n) if valid_sequence[i] == i + 1) == 1
postconditions.description: There is exactly one root in the valid sequence.

postconditions.expression: all((i + 1, valid_sequence[i]) in edges or (valid_sequence[i], i + 1) in edges for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: Each vertex is connected to its parent in the valid sequence.
The valid sequence forms a tree with n-1 edges.
